meta.description: Detect distant homologs using profile and structure-aware methods that go beyond standard BLAST.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All measured values in the executed outputs came from local tool output; the two reasoning outputs retained uncertainty rather than fabricating a biological conclusion.

practice_boundaries.detail: No individual diagnosis, treatment, or prescriptive medical claim was generated.

methodological_ground.detail: The Skill consistently distinguishes statistical support, structural similarity, homology, and functional inference. Input 11 found an incomplete masking command, not a fallacious inference.

code_usability.detail: All four shipped shell scripts passed bash -n and the three executable workflows completed on cached fixtures. The documented segmasker command runs but is functionally incomplete; it is tracked as P1.

functional_suitability.note: The decision matrix covers all claimed tool families and the repaired examples execute. Correctness is 3/4 because the low-complexity mitigation command only reports intervals and does not create a masked sequence for downstream profile construction.

reliability.note: Scripts use set -euo pipefail, provide a real zero-hit Pfam result, save PSSMs, and cache databases. Fault tolerance is capped because the stated low-complexity recovery action does not deliver its promised masked FASTA.

performance_context.note: The 296-line SKILL.md routes users through a compact decision matrix, points to executable examples, and avoids duplicated usage-guide content.

agent_usability.note: Clear setup, method selection, thresholds, output fields, and failure modes make cold-start use strong. Error prevention is reduced by the low-complexity command that does not complete the stated mitigation.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language, explicit version introspection, and direct example prompts make the Skill discoverable and forgiving of tool-version drift.

security.note: No credentials or sensitive data are embedded. Positional file inputs are quoted in shipped scripts, but file existence and output-path validation remain delegated to the CLIs.

maintainability.note: Foldseek, iterative-profile, and Pfam workflows are separated into tested examples with a bundled toy fixture. PSI-BLAST-alone and HHsearch-alone remain inline rather than standalone examples.

agent_specific.note: The trigger is precise; usage-guide, SKILL.md, and examples layer well; related-skill boundaries and uncertainty escape hatches are explicit. PSI-BLAST DB/order sensitivity prevents perfect idempotency.

key_strengths: All shipped shell workflows pass syntax validation and completed on realistic cached molecular fixtures.
The Phase 1 HMMER checkpoint-prefix and Foldseek file-prefix cache fixes were independently reproduced at the audited tip.
The Skill preserves quantitative uncertainty and separates structural similarity from functional inference.
A bundled Pfam toy fixture permits a real hmmscan regression without downloading the full Pfam-A database.

recommendations.title: Make the low-complexity mitigation produce masked FASTA
recommendations.problem: The documented segmasker command prints only interval coordinates, so it does not create the masked query that the next profile-building command must consume.
recommendations.root_cause: The failure-mode section names a detection-only invocation but omits segmasker's output format and file handoff.
recommendations.fix: Replace the command with segmasker -infmt fasta -in query.fa -outfmt fasta > query.masked.fa, then explicitly use query.masked.fa for profile construction. State that the lowercase output is soft masking.

recommendations.title: Add standalone PSI-BLAST and HHsearch examples
recommendations.problem: PSI-BLAST-alone and HHsearch-alone are runnable inline blocks but do not have companion example scripts like the other central workflows.
recommendations.root_cause: The executable examples focus on comparative iterative search, Pfam, and Foldseek.
recommendations.fix: When production databases are available, add small parameterized scripts or explicit runnable mini-fixtures for saved-PSSM reuse and HHsearch output inspection.
